people.name: Pascual Ortiz Rubio
people.nameZh: 帕斯夸爾·奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧

body.zh-Hant: 奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧1877年3月10日生於米卻肯州莫雷利亞。他在聖尼古拉學院讀預科，1896年以學生領袖身分反對迪亞斯連任；1902年在國立礦業學院完成地形工程學位，之後回到莫雷利亞投入地方政治。
body.en: Ortiz Rubio was born on 10 March 1877 in Morelia, Michoacán. He attended preparatory school at the Colegio de San Nicolás and, as a student leader, opposed the reelection of Porfirio Díaz in 1896; he completed a topographical engineering degree at the National College of Mines in 1902 and returned to Morelia to take part in local politics.

citations.quote: b. 10 March 1877; d. 4 November 1963
was born in Morelia, Michoacán
attended preparatory school at the famous Colegio de San Nicolás
as a student leader opposed the reelection of Porfirio Díaz in 1896
completed his topographical engineering degree at the National College of Mines
(later the National School of Engineering) in 1902 and returned to Morelia
where he soon involved himself in local politics

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、被囚與立憲派軍職

body.zh-Hant: 馬德羅勝利後，他當選1912至1913年的聯邦議員，屬「革新派」。馬德羅遇害後，韋爾塔1913年將他關押；獲釋後他加入立憲派，任工兵上校。1914年他負責政府的敵產並主管聯邦印花局；1915年升至准將，負責工程補給，其後主持戰爭部的軍事工程局。
body.en: Elected to the 1912-1913 federal legislature after Madero's victory, he joined the "Renovation Group". After Madero's murder Victoriano Huerta imprisoned him in 1913; once released he joined the Constitutionalists as a colonel of engineers. In 1914 he was in charge of enemy properties and directed the federal stamp bureau; by 1915 he was a brigadier general responsible for engineering supplies, and he later directed the military engineers department of the war secretariat.

citations.quote: Elected to the 1912–1913 federal legislature after Madero's victory
he became a member of the "Renovation Group."
After Madero's murder, Victoriano Huerta imprisoned him in 1913.
After his release, Ortiz Rubio joined the Constitutionalists

In 1914, he was in charge of enemy properties for the Mexican government
and directed the federal stamp bureau
By 1915, he had risen to the rank of brigadier general
responsible for engineering supplies
directed the department of military engineers for the secretariat of war

heading.zh-Hant: 米卻肯州長與通訊部長
heading.en: Governor of Michoacán and Secretary of Communications

body.zh-Hant: 1917至1920年他任米卻肯州長；UAM學者稱他是該州第一位憲政州長，埃爾科萊希奧的研究則寫他領導的派系勝出並治理該州直到1920年。1920年他支持阿瓜普列塔叛亂，獲邀加入臨時總統德拉韋爾塔的內閣，出任通訊部長（百科記為1920至1921年）。
body.en: He served as governor of Michoacán in 1917-1920; a UAM study calls him the first constitutional governor of the state, and a study from El Colegio de Michoacán says the group he led prevailed and governed the state until 1920. After supporting the Agua Prieta rebellion in 1920 he was invited into the cabinet of interim president Adolfo de la Huerta as Secretary of Communications (1920-1921 in the encyclopedia entry).

citations.quote: governor of his home state (1917–1920)
fue el primer gobernador constitucional del estado (1917-1920)
el grupo lidereado por Ortiz Rubio se impuso sobre sus opositores
gobernó el estado hasta 1920
al apoyar la rebelión de Agua Prieta en 1920
para formar parte del gabinete del presidente interino Adolfo de la Huerta
la designación de Pascual Ortiz Rubio como Secretario de Comunicaciones
secretary of communications and public works (1920–1921)

heading.zh-Hant: 駐德國與巴西外交任務
heading.en: Diplomatic missions to Germany and Brazil

body.zh-Hant: 墨西哥外交部資料庫記載，奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧1923年11月23日獲任為駐德國特命全權公使，任務於1926年1月7日結束；1926年1月7日起任駐巴西特命全權大使，任務至1929年2月28日止。百科條目也寫卡列斯任命他先後出任駐德國與巴西大使。
body.en: The Mexican Foreign Ministry database records Ortiz Rubio as envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary to Germany from his appointment on 23 November 1923, the mission ending on 7 January 1926; he was then ambassador extraordinary and plenipotentiary to Brazil from 7 January 1926 until 28 February 1929. The encyclopedia entry likewise says President Calles appointed him ambassador to Germany and then Brazil.

citations.quote: Pascual Ortiz Rubio EEMP 23 nov. 1923 31 dic. 1923 7 ene. 1926
citations.evidenceNote: 表頭欄位為 Nombramiento／Presentación de cartas credenciales／Fin de misión；本筆起日取第一欄 Nombramiento

citations.evidenceNote: 同上；迄日取 Fin de misión

citations.quote: president Calles appointed him ambassador to Germany and then Brazil.

body.zh-Hant: 1929年他成為國民革命黨（PNR）的總統候選人，在與巴斯孔塞洛斯競爭激烈的選舉中當選。任期為1930年2月5日至1932年9月4日（德國國家圖書館權威檔記為1930至1932年）；任內前總統卡列斯在幕後權力極大，奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧為抗議自己缺乏總統的主權與權威而辭職。
body.en: In 1929 he became the National Revolutionary Party (PNR) presidential candidate and was elected in a hotly contested race with José Vasconcelos. His administration ran from 5 February 1930 to 4 September 1932 (the German National Library record gives 1930-1932); former president Calles remained so powerful behind the scenes that Ortiz Rubio resigned in protest at his lack of presidential sovereignty and authority.

citations.quote: He became the National Revolutionary Party's presidential candidate in 1929.
He was elected in a hotly contested presidential race with José Vasconcelos
(5 February 1930 to 4 September 1932)
1930-1932 Präsident von Mexiko
Plutarco Elías Calles (1924–1928) remained so powerful behind the scenes
resigned in protest against his lack of presidential sovereignty

body.zh-Hant: 百科條目寫他1932年辭去總統職務，是1913年以來唯一辭職的墨西哥人；之後前往美國，1935年返回墨西哥。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他卒於1963年11月4日。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry says he resigned the presidency in 1932, the only Mexican to do so since 1913, and went to the United States; he returned to Mexico in 1935. The German National Library authority record gives his death as 4 November 1963.

body.zh-Hant: 法利埃1841年11月6日生於洛特-加龍省的梅津。他在巴黎讀完法律後，在內拉克律師公會註冊；1870年9月4日出任內拉克市議員並任市長，1871年10月起任內拉克的縣級議員（conseiller général）。
body.en: Fallières was born on 6 November 1841 at Mézin (Lot-et-Garonne). After studying law in Paris he enrolled at the bar of Nérac; on 4 September 1870 he became a municipal councillor and mayor of Nérac, and from October 1871 he sat as conseiller général for Nérac.

citations.quote: 6 novembre 1841 Naissance de Clément, Armand Fallières, à Mézin (Lot-et-Garonne)
Après des études de droit faites à Paris, il s'inscrit au barreau de Nérac.
4 septembre 1870 Conseiller municipal et maire de Nérac
En octobre 1871 Conseiller général de Nérac

body.zh-Hant: 1876至1889年，法利埃是內拉克的共和派眾議員。1880年5月17日至1881年11月任內政與宗教事務次長；1882年9月13日至1883年1月28日任內政與宗教部長，1883年1月29日起出任部長會議主席（總理）。1890年3月17日至1892年2月任司法與宗教部長。
body.en: From 1876 to 1889 Fallières was the republican deputy for Nérac. He was under-secretary of state for the Interior and Religious Affairs from 17 May 1880 to November 1881, Minister of the Interior and Religious Affairs from 13 September 1882 to 28 January 1883, and from 29 January 1883 Président du Conseil. From 17 March 1890 to February 1892 he was Minister of Justice and Religious Affairs.

citations.quote: 1876-1889 Député républicain de Nérac
17 mai 1880-13 novembre 1881 Sous-secrétaire d'État à l'Intérieur et aux Cultes
13 septembre 1882-28 janvier 1883 Ministre de l'Intérieur et des Cultes
29 janvier-20 février 1883 Président du Conseil
17 mars 1890 - 26 février 1892 Ministre de la Justice et des Cultes

heading.en: Senator and President of the Senate

body.zh-Hant: 1890年，法利埃當選洛特-加龍省參議員，1897年1月3日與1906年1月7日再度當選。1899年3月3日他出任參議院議長；參議員任期在1906年2月13日因辭職而結束。
body.en: Fallières was elected senator for Lot-et-Garonne in 1890 and re-elected on 3 January 1897 and 7 January 1906. On 3 March 1899 he became President of the Senate; his senatorial mandate ended on 13 February 1906 by resignation.

citations.quote: Elu le 8 juin 1890 Elu le 3 janvier 1897 Elu le 7 janvier 1906
3 mars 1899 Président du Sénat
Fin de mandat le 13 février 1906 ( Démissionnaire )

body.zh-Hant: 1906年2月17日，法利埃繼盧貝出任共和國總統。任內他指派克列孟梭、白里安、卡約、普安卡雷等人領導政府。1908年5月25至29日他訪問英國，7月18日至8月4日訪問北歐各國首都，並於7月27日在雷瓦爾會見沙皇尼古拉二世。1913年2月17日的官方年表記普安卡雷當選總統，法利埃自此完全退出政壇。
body.en: On 17 February 1906 Fallières succeeded Émile Loubet as President of the Republic. He named Clemenceau, Briand, Caillaux and Poincaré to head the government. He travelled to England on 25-29 May 1908 and to the Scandinavian capitals from 18 July to 4 August 1908, meeting Tsar Nicholas II at Reval on 27 July. The official chronology records Raymond Poincaré elected president on 17 February 1913, after which Fallières withdrew definitively from political life.

citations.quote: 17 février 1906 Président de la République à la suite d’ Émile Loubet
Il désigne à la tête du gouvernement plusieurs personnalités éminentes
Clemenceau, Briand, Caillaux, Poincaré.
25-29 mai 1908 Voyage du président en Angleterre
18 juillet-4 août 1908 Voyage du président dans les capitales scandinaves
Il rencontre le tsar Nicolas II à Reval le 27 juillet.
17 février 1913 Raymond Poincaré est élu président de la République.
Armand Fallières se retire définitivement de la vie politique.

body.zh-Hant: 退出政壇後，法利埃把大部分時間花在梅津；1931年6月22日他在梅津去世，德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他卒於1931年6月22日。
body.en: After leaving office Fallières spent most of his time at Mézin, where he died on 22 June 1931; the German National Library authority record also gives 22 June 1931 as his death date.

citations.quote: passant désormais la plus grande partie de son temps à Mézin

people.name: Federico Alberto Tinoco Granados
people.nameZh: 費德里科·蒂諾科·格拉納多斯

body.zh-Hant: 蒂諾科在聖荷西出生，在卡爾塔戈的耶穌會學校讀小學，後進入美國的一所軍事學院，再到布魯塞爾雅典學院讀了四年。1895年他返回哥斯大黎加，在父親位於胡安維尼亞斯的咖啡與甘蔗園工作；1898年與瑪麗亞·費爾南德斯結婚。
body.en: Tinoco was born in San José, did his primary schooling at the Jesuit college in Cartago, entered a military academy in the United States, and then studied for four years at the Athénée in Brussels. He returned to Costa Rica in 1895 to work on his father's coffee and sugar-cane estates at Juan Viñas, and in 1898 he married María Fernández Le Capellain.

Realiza los estudios primarios en el Colegio Jesuita de Cartago
ingresando luego a la Academia Militar de Bryand en Rosslin
ingresa al Ateneo de Bruselas, Bélgica, donde estudia por cuatro años
En 1895 regresa al país

heading.zh-Hant: 議員與戰爭與海軍部長
heading.en: Deputy and Secretary of War and the Navy

body.zh-Hant: 蒂諾科是共和黨黨員，1908年當選議員。1914年選舉後的動亂以阿爾弗雷多·岡薩雷斯·弗洛雷斯被召任總統告終，新總統任命他為戰爭與海軍部長。百科條目說，政變發生時他同時是戰爭與海軍部長、聖荷西司令和警察首長。
body.en: Tinoco was a militant of the Republican Party and was elected deputy in 1908. The disturbances after the 1914 elections ended with Alfredo González Flores being called to the presidency, and the new president named him Secretary of War and the Navy. The encyclopedia entry says that at the time of the coup he was minister of war and the navy, commandant of San José and head of the police.

citations.quote: Militante del Partido Republicano, en 1908 es electo Diputado
los disturbios que tienen lugar después de las elecciones de 1914
llamamiento de Alfredo González Flores para ejercer la Presidencia
El nuevo Presidente nombra a Tinoco Granados como Secretario de Guerra y Marina.
minister of war and the navy, commandant of San José, and head of the police

heading.en: The 1917 coup and election as president

body.zh-Hant: 1917年1月27日，蒂諾科以政變取得政權，推翻了他的上司、總統岡薩雷斯·弗洛雷斯。《Estudios》期刊引述的當時文字稱他宣布自己是臨時總統。國家檔案館說明稱，制憲議會1917年4月選他為共和國總統。
body.en: On 27 January 1917 Tinoco took power by coup d'état, overthrowing President González Flores, whose war minister he was. The journal Estudios quotes a contemporary text stating that he proclaimed himself provisional president. The National Archives description says a constituent assembly elected him President of the Republic in April 1917.

citations.quote: Tinoco Granados asume el poder mediante golpe de Estado el 27 de enero de 1917
fue derrocado por su Ministro de Guerra Federico Tinoco Granados.
se proclama Presidente provisorio de la República
la cual en abril de 1917 lo elige Presidente de la República

body.zh-Hant: 美國政府不承認蒂諾科政府。哥斯大黎加期刊論文寫，1918年2月至1919年8月間出現多起反抗蒂諾科家族的武裝運動；德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他向德意志帝國宣戰，1919年被推翻並流亡。國家檔案館說明稱，他在1919年8月12日把權力交給第一副總統胡安·包蒂斯塔·基羅斯。
body.en: The United States did not recognise Tinoco's government. A Costa Rican journal article says that between February 1918 and August 1919 several armed movements arose against the Tinocos; the German National Library authority record says he declared war on the German Empire and was ousted and exiled in 1919. According to the National Archives description he handed over power on 12 August 1919 to the First Designate, Juan Bautista Quirós.

citations.quote: su gobierno no es reconocido por el de los Estados Unidos de América
Entre febrero de 1918 y agosto de 1919, surgieron varios movimientos armados
erklärte dem Deutschen Reich den Krieg, 1919 entmachtet und exiliert
Federico Tinoco se ve obligado a entregar el poder el 12 de agosto de 1919
al Primer Designado a la Presidencia, Juan Bautista Quirós

body.zh-Hant: 交出權力後，蒂諾科乘船前往歐洲，1931年9月7日在巴黎去世。德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他卒於1931年，百科條目則說他死在巴黎。
body.en: After giving up power Tinoco sailed for Europe and died in Paris on 7 September 1931. The German National Library authority record gives 1931 as the year of his death, and the encyclopedia entry says he died in Paris.
